 "content": "def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    points = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 1]
    if len(points) < 2:
        return out
    points.sort()
    dr = points[1][0] - points[0][0]
    dc = points[1][1] - points[0][1]
    # Continue the regular diagonal progression, marking newly extrapolated points.
    r, c = points[-1]
    while 0 <= r + dr < len(out) and 0 <= c + dc < len(out[0]):
        r += dr
        c += dc
        if out[r][c] == 0:
            out[r][c] = 2
    return out
